idea-plugin.name: Config & DSL Lint + Snippets
idea-plugin.description:
Your config files are never compiled — nothing fails until deploy. 36 snippets and 28 lint rules for 9 of them, inside the editor, offline.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Config & DSL Lint + Snippets: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/config-dsl-lint-snippet-pack (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/config-dsl-lint-snippet-pack

action.text: Config & DSL Lint + Snippets: Check This File
action.description: Run Config & DSL Lint + Snippets on the file in the editor
